::: {.card-title}
Delay-Difference Stock Assessment Model
:::

::: {.card-desc}
Fits a Deriso-Schnute delay-difference model with Beverton-Holt recruitment to catch and CPUE data. Uses JAX automatic differentiation for fast optimization and exact standard errors. Upload your own data or run the Patagonian toothfish example.
:::

::: {.card-note}
Hosted on Hugging Face. If the app has been idle it may take about a minute to wake up.
:::
